items.ti: 나는 Doug Burgum 장관의 후원 하에 내무부가 유명한 골프 코스 설계자인 Tom Fazio와 협력하여 현재 워싱턴 D.C.에 위치한 이스트 포토맥 골프 링크 부지에 월드 클래스 챔피언십 골프 코스를 건설할 계획을 개발했음을 발표하게 된 것을 기쁘게 생각합니다. 완공되면 이 골프 코스는 대중에게 공개되는 동시에 최고 수준의 골프로 설계되어 미국과 같은 월드 클래스 토너먼트를 개최할 수 있게 됩니다. 오픈, PGA 챔피언십, 라이더 컵, 프레지던츠 컵. 이 과정은 많은 일자리를 창출하고 워싱턴 D.C.와 주변 지역에 엄청나게 긍정적인 경제 개발 영향을 미칠 것입니다. 수백만 달러가 수도권에 투자될 것입니다. 현재의 강좌는 오래되고, 깨졌고, 황폐해져서 더 이상 쓸모가 없거나 효과가 없습니다. 낙하, 위험, 질병 등 매우 열악한 상태입니다.
items.ti_en: I am pleased to announce that the Department of the Interior, under the auspices of Secretary Doug Burgum, and in conjunction with famed Golf Course Architect, Tom Fazio, has developed a plan to build a World Class Championship Golf Course on the site of the current East Potomac Golf Links, located in Washington, D.C. When completed, it will be open to the Public while, at the same time, designed to the Highest Level of Golf and able to hold World Class Tournaments such as the U.S. Open, the PGA Championship, the Ryder Cup, and the Presidents Cup. This Course will create many Jobs, and have a tremendously positive Economic Development impact on Washington, D.C., and the surrounding area. Millions of Dollars will inure to the Capital area. The current Course is old, broken, dilapidated, and of no further use or effect. It is in very poor condition, with falling, dangerous, and disease infested trees and, importantly, a collapsing and hazardous seawall. When the East Potomac Course was originally built, it was famous for no trees, with views of Washington, D.C., for all to see, but now, it is completely overgrown, dysfunctional, and unsafe. Restoration work will begin on the Fazio Design on November 15th, when the old Course will be closed to play. The new Course will be opened in approximately 15 months. The United States Golf Association, PGA of America, and the PGA Tour have already been notified that they will soon have one of the Best and Most Spectacular Golf Courses anywhere in the World to put on their list of great places to play, and hold Major Events. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
